usage: niagara_help [-h] [--niagara-version VERSION]
                    {class,search,guide,guide-search,devguide,pdf,method,source,package,slots,module,type,palette,tag,lexicon,find,devguide-search,stats,source-grep,coverage,freshness,rebuild-all,selftest,versions} ...

Niagara N4 Documentation Navigator

positional arguments:
  {class,search,guide,guide-search,devguide,pdf,method,source,package,slots,module,type,palette,tag,lexicon,find,devguide-search,stats,source-grep,coverage,freshness,rebuild-all,selftest,versions}
                        Available commands
    class               Look up a class by name (package, inheritance, methods)
    search              Search classes by glob pattern
    guide               Search guides by topic/folder
    guide-search        Full-text search in guides-clean/ with relevance ranking
    devguide            Search Developer Guide TOC
    pdf                 Search PDFs by name and full-text
    method              Search methods/fields/constructors by name
    source              Look up or view Java source code
    package             Browse classes by package
    slots               Search/view @NiagaraProperty, @NiagaraAction, @NiagaraTopic
    module              Module descriptor (module.xml): dependencies both ways, types, permissions
    type                Niagara type (module:Type): its module, class, docs and the agents (views)
                        on it
    palette             Shipped palettes (*.palette): where a type or folder sits, or a module's
                        palette tree
    tag                 Tag dictionaries (Haystack, Niagara): a tag's kind, doc, supertypes,
                        protos and N4 rules
    lexicon             Lexicon entries (*.lexicon): a key's value in each language, the base
                        value next to each translation
    find                Unified full-text search across ALL sources with relevance ranking
    devguide-search     Full-text search in devguide-clean/ with relevance ranking
    stats               Corpus overview with counts and sizes
    source-grep         Full-text regex search across ALL source files
    coverage            Documentation coverage report (overview exits 1 on guide folders with
                        unindexed HTML pages)
    freshness           Check whether indexes are in sync with the raw corpus
    rebuild-all         Rebuild all indexes in dependency order, then stamp the manifest
    selftest            Assert core search behaviours (exits non-zero on failure)
    versions            Manage Niagara versions: 'versions add <install>' onboards a new install
                        in one command (exit 0 ready, 1 a gate failed, 2 cannot add); 'versions
                        list'

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --niagara-version VERSION
                        Niagara version to query (default from versions/registry.json; env
                        NIAGARA_HELP_VERSION). Accepted anywhere on the command line.
